cāreti.cp: caus. of carati. causes to set going; causes to pasture; causes to feast one's senses.
cāreti.p: [Cara+ṇe+ti] (kri) CL=10 (1) Wanders; moves; inhabits; goes around. (2) Aims. (3) Hits. (4) Judges. (5) Carries. (6) Puts into. Cāreti (kā,kri) [cara+ṇe+ti]  (1) makes one to move; to turn; (2) Makes spread; Spread out; Stretches. (3) (A) Wanders; moves; inhabits; goes around; Makes take sense. (B) Let move; Let wander; Let inhabit; Let graze. (4) Make become; Make a doing. (5) Makes move; Makes draw; Makes chop.
